title: Native Messaging response, protocol 1
description: Message sent by the native host to the extension. Exactly one of 'result' (success) or 'error' (failure). The result shape depends on the correlated request action; see results.schema.json. requestId may be null only when the request could not be parsed. Validation order on the host: framing and size, UTF-8 JSON without duplicate keys, then the 'protocol' field, then the full schema. A request with an unsupported protocol number is answered with a protocol-1 failure envelope carrying VERSION_UNSUPPORTED and supportedProtocolVersions.
